checks.name: Permission filtering
checks.behavior: A user can see only documents allowed by their current permissions.
checks.description: Three searches by Acme users with different grants.

checks.name: Cross-company isolation
checks.behavior: Identical searches by different companies cannot leak documents across companies.
checks.description: Alice at Acme and Carol at Birch run the same query.

checks.name: Revocation takes effect
checks.behavior: Removing a user's access takes effect on the next request, including a cached request.
checks.description: Alice searches, an administrator revokes one document, Alice searches again.

checks.name: Repeated searches avoid work
checks.behavior: Repeated authorized searches avoid repeating the expensive search operation where possible.
checks.description: Three searches for the same query; the index may be scanned at most twice.
